theme_and_archetype.description: A clean, professional B2B dashboard infused with a fresh, organic farm-market aesthetic. Moves away from cold corporate SaaS templates by using warm paper/cream backgrounds, deep botanical greens, and tactile borders. Avoids generic tech gradients (no purple/teal).

typography.rules: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Optimize for a blend of organic warmth and B2B data density.

headings.weight_strategy: Use font-light or font-normal for a premium, editorial, farm-to-table feel. Avoid heavy font-black unless for critical numeric stats.

body.weight_strategy: Clean, highly legible geometric sans for tabular data and forms. Use font-medium for table headers.

mono.usage: For order IDs, SKUs, and numeric data in the combined purchase sheet.

colors.philosophy: Tinted neutrals. Never use pure #000000 or neutral grays. All grays must be tinted with warm beige or olive. Contrast must pass WCAG AA.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 to p-8 for internal card padding to prevent data collision.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-6. Strict hierarchy, every pixel utilized but breathing.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align tabular data (strings) and right-align numeric data (quantities, prices). Center-align status badges.
spacing_and_layout.page_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8

cards.style: Neumorphic-Crisp. bg-white, 1px border border-[#E5E0D8], rounded-xl, soft shadow shadow-sm. Never use heavy box shadows.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-[#163820] transition-colors rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-[#E2DCCF] border border-[#E5E0D8] transition-colors rounded-md

tables.style: B2B Dense but breathable. Use Shadcn Table. border-b border-[#E5E0D8] on rows.
tables.header: bg-[#F7F5F0] text-muted-foreground font-medium text-xs uppercase tracking-wider py-3 px-4

inputs.style: Shadcn standard but customized radius and border. rounded-md border-[#E5E0D8] bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1F4A2C] focus:border-transparent transition-all

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must explicitly set hover colors (e.g., hover:bg-[#163820] hover:text-white).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for buttons and inputs.
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Subtle fade-in for dashboard widgets (framer-motion or simple CSS animation opacity 0 -> 1 over 300ms).
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Ensure focus states (focus:ring) have minimum 3:1 contrast against adjacent colors.

icons_and_assets.style: Stroke width 1.5 for a sophisticated, lighter B2B feel.
icons_and_assets.usage: Use icons for sidebar navigation, status indicators, and action buttons (export, add, delete).

media_and_images.rules: Main agent MUST use these URLs. Missing categories must not use placeholder text.

auth_background.description: Colorful assortment of fresh vegetables in a local market setting. Use with a #1F4A2C/60 overlay to ensure login form readability.

wholesale_decorative.description: A wooden crate with fresh vegetables loaded inside a delivery truck. Use for empty states or onboarding screens.

dashboard_fallback.description: Variety of vegetables. Subtle farm market vibe.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based format.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Initialize the project with Vite/React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui.
2. Inject the custom Google Fonts (Fraunces, Albert Sans, JetBrains Mono) into the index.html head.
3. Apply the custom color tokens into tailwind.config.js (extend colors array).
4. Set the global background color to #F7F5F0 and text color to #2D312E in index.css.
5. Build the Auth flow (Hotel Login & Admin Login) using the auth_background image with a dark green overlay.
6. Build the Admin Dashboard: Sidebar navigation, Stats Cards (Total Hotels, Pending Orders, Qty Today) utilizing the Bento grid.
7. Implement the 'Combined Purchase Sheet' with a Date Picker, aggregating quantities of Potato, Onion, Tomato, Apple, etc.
8. Implement the 'Order Placement Form' for Hotels, allowing dynamic quantity inputs for catalog items.
9. Style all Shadcn UI components (Cards, Tables, Inputs, Buttons) strictly according to the 'components' section in this JSON.
10. Ensure all elements have appropriate data-testid attributes for testing.
